# Lens tabs

Source: https://github.com/ruiqichenbiec/design-systems

Pinned commit: `7a424c93b9be13cf835b91ea67495fec2ec0584e`

File: `lens/lab/design-system/component-patterns.js`, segmented tabs implementation.
Copyright © 2026 DayDreamInAReverie. MIT license in `LICENSE-lens.txt`.

MewCode adapts the existing tab construction, selection, roving keyboard focus,
panel relationships and resize indicator to a standalone native ES module.
Dock, component registry, optics, WebGL, sound and custom events were removed;
CSS uses the workbench's accessible color tokens and reduced-motion preference.
No runtime CDN or framework is required.
